Country and location Injured: France, Mayotte offshore, 40 km east southeast of Pamandzi
Notes: This quake was the strongest of an earthquake swarm with at least 36 quakes throughout the whole day. Six people were injured.
Homes were damaged and social facilities disrupted. One person died and 31 others were taken to the hospital.
A school collapsed in Mangaldai, and two students were injured in a classroom.

Country and location Injured: Colombia, 13 km east southeast of Tangua
Notes: More than 100 houses were severely damaged near the epicenter in Nariño department. Two people were killed in Pasto, crushed by their house, and 7 others injured.

Country and location Injured: Indonesia, East Java offshore, 3 km east northeast of Sumenep
Notes: Dozens of houses and two mosques were damaged in Sumenep. Six people were injured.

Country and location Injured: Iran, North Khorasan, 28 km west southwest of Bojnurd
Notes: Two people were injured and some buildings were damaged in Jajarm.[better source needed]

Country and location Injured: Japan, 2 km northwest of Hirakata , Osaka
Notes: The 2018 Osaka earthquake destroyed several buildings and temples in the region, caused power failures, and damaged roads badly. Four people were killed and more than 400 others injured.

Country and location Injured: Vanuatu, 27 km west southwest of Port-Vila
Notes: Slight damage was caused to stores in Port-Vila.

Country and location Injured: Iran, 32 km northeast of Sarpol-e Zahab
Notes: Twelve people were treated for their injuries. It was an aftershock of the 2017 Iran–Iraq earthquake.
